decisions.reason: The existing message-184 MODIFY already makes the confirmation-email referral-code copy non-optional, so no additional or corrected Event is required.
Making the referral code mandatory in the confirmation email does not change the NFT metadata attributes or their referral-code source.
The source changes where the referral code is displayed, not the commission amount, trigger, recipient, destination, timing, or limits.
The confirmation-email display decision does not affect commission allocation when no referral code is supplied.
The same-message INTRODUCE already records the confirmation-email and dashboard access paths, while referral-code email contents are owned by the certificate-email Requirement.
The source does not require the About page to describe the referral code's confirmation-email display surface.
The existing message-184 INTRODUCE already requires the certificate email to contain the mint number as the referral code.
Changing a referral-code display surface does not alter which NFT state or entitlements transfer on resale.
Referral-code inclusion in a confirmation email does not change prize-winner notification behavior; the separate message-184 notification update is already represented.
The referral-code display change does not alter badge triggers, milestones, or on-chain recording.
The confirmation-email display change does not alter winner eligibility, ticket weighting, randomness, or verification.
The referral-code display decision does not affect prize delivery; the separate automatic-transfer decision from message 184 is already fully represented.
